# Scraps

Part of the **Inventory** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List scraps

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/scraps`

Retrieve a paginated list of scraps with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: product, uom, lot, package, partner, operation, sourceLocation, destinationLocation, company, creator, tags, moves, moveLines | `product,sourceLocation` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by | `architecto` |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by scrap name | `SP/1` |
| `filter[state]` | string | No | Filter by scrap state | `draft` |
| `filter[product_id]` | string | No | Filter by product IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[source_location_id]` | string | No | Filter by source location IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[destination_location_id]` | string | No | Filter by destination location IDs | `architecto` |
| `sort` | string | No | Sort field | `-created_at` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/scraps?include=product%2CsourceLocation&filter%5Bid%5D=architecto&filter%5Bname%5D=SP%2F1&filter%5Bstate%5D=draft&filter%5Bproduct_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Bsource_location_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Bdestination_location_id%5D=architecto&sort=-created_at" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]

  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

## Create scrap

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/scraps`

Create a new scrap

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `origin` | string | No | Source document reference. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `qty` | number | Yes | Quantity to scrap. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `product_id` | integer | Yes | Product ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `uom_id` | integer | No | Unit of measure ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `lot_id` | integer | No | Lot ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `package_id` | integer | No | Package ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `partner_id` | integer | No | Owner partner ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `source_location_id` | integer | No | Source location ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `destination_location_id` | integer | No | Destination scrap location ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `tags` | integer[] | No | Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/scraps" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "origin": "WH/OUT/0001",
  "qty": 2,
  "product_id": 1,
  "uom_id": 1,
  "lot_id": 1,
  "package_id": 1,
  "partner_id": 1,
  "source_location_id": 1,
  "destination_location_id": 2,
  "company_id": 1,
  "tags": [
    16
  ]
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]

  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",

  "origin": "WH/OUT/0001",

  "partner_id": 1,
  "source_location_id": 1,
  "destination_location_id": 2,
  "company_id": 1,
  "tags": [
    16
  ]
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```
